title: Duplicate bill upload of an already-matched bill — duplicate-document guard (AP)
narrative: AP duplicate-document test, previously inexpressible without reconciliation_status. An identical Oxbridge bill (ref 7FC4A3D8-0001, EUR 745.00) was uploaded earlier and matched to tx-oxbridge-paid, which now carries reconciliation_status='reconciled'; firm_context.settlement reports this bill fully settled (paid). This row is the DUPLICATE upload. The settling line still appears in the window, and an unrelated same-vendor debit is present as noise. GOLD: abstain with unmatchable_reason 'already_settled' — a duplicate document must not create a second match against a line already reconciled to its twin. FAILURE TO CATCH: re-proposing the reconciled line, producing a phantom double-payment.
